Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that blue light corresponds to the coolest temperature and red light corresponds to the hottest temperature, which contradicts the principle of blackbody radiation. In reality, shorter wavelengths (blue light) indicate higher temperatures, and longer wavelengths (red light) indicate lower temperatures. This fundamental misunderstanding led to the wrong solution being provided (Answer B) instead of the correct answer (Answer A).
